ctx.x: So the band, they came back to Pittsburgh, and I went to St. Louis, as far as St. Louis with Mary. So Mary says, "Listen, Kenny --," Jeter - Wilbur Kirk was playing with this band, Jeeter Piller's band, in St. Louis, and they were working at the Plantation Club, you know, with Ziggy Johnson, these big shows and things, from Chicago, you know.
